ns2:section.sectionText: Integration of the four skills of reading, writing, listening, and speaking; special focus on advanced academic writing at the graduate level, including writing such as research reports, theses, as appropriate; review of principles of writing including writing from sources. Approved for S/U grading only. Credit may not be used toward a graduate degree. Prerequisite: ESL 501, or recommendation from UIUC English as a Second Language Placement Test. Proof of eligibility must be brought to the first meeting of the class. Learn how to register for this course at http://www.uiucesl.com/
